allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Fitzcarraldo is a dreamer who plans to build an opera house in Iquitos, in the Peruvian Amazon, so, in order to finance his project, he embarks on an epic adventure to collect rubber, a very profitable product, in a remote and unexplored region of the rainforest.

facts.title: Fitzcarraldo

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can an audacious artistic dream survive an unforgiving trek through the heart of the rainforest?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Driven by an ambition to build an opera house in the Peruvian Amazon, dreamer Fitzcarraldo mounts a daring expedition into an uncharted jungle territory to secure a fortune in rubber.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: An immersive, thoughtful adventure with steady momentum, tailored for dedicated solo viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Werner Herzog channels monumental ambition into a sprawling, immersive drama where culture and untamed wilderness collide.
